notes:
Feed for Linave Transportes (lead operator of Consórcio Reserva de Tinguá / Mobilidade NI), Nova Iguaçu, Baixada Fluminense, RJ. All lines are informal/urban city buses (route_type=3); no metro/rail is operated by this operator, so METRO/RAIL-first does not apply. Route roster confirmed across onibus.online, horariosonibus.com and Moovit: 155I, 585I, 607I, 608I built here (best documented, with itinerary endpoints + published operating hours). Other roster lines (434L, 605I, 610I, 705I, 840I) exist but lacked stop-level data, so were not fabricated.

Stops: only stops evidenced by Moovit line pages / itinerary text or with published/known coordinates are included. Coordinates are WGS-84 from IBGE/OSM/Wikipedia sources:
- Rodoviária de Nova Iguaçu / Ponto Final Linave (Av. Mal. Floriano Peixoto): -22.75731,-43.45613 (OSM way 451926078).
- Praça Carlos Gomes (Centro, CEP 26215-030): -22.75371,-43.45016 (IBGE).
- Av. Gov. Roberto Silveira / UFRRJ (Centro): -22.69183,-43.50785 (IBGE/OSM).
- Queimados centro: -22.7107,-43.5522 (Wikipedia/IBGE).
- Austin bairro ref (Rua Cel. Monteiro de Barros): -22.7154,-43.5271.
- Jaceruba: -22.59816,-43.56366 (OSM).
- Nossa Senhora do Rosário / Austin-Queimados edge: -22.7130,-43.5400 (approx neighborhood centroid, near Queimados; flagged approximate).
- Bairro Paraíso (Av. Dr. Pedro Jorge, terminus of 607I): -22.7280,-43.4700 (approx, Nova Iguaçu; street-level not resolved to a precise node).
Intermediate stops between named endpoints are NOT enumerated because Moovit per-line PDFs did not decode to text; each route therefore carries only its evidenced endpoints/major waypoints (a skeleton itinerary), not the full 70-84 stop chains Moovit reports.

Service: daily (Mon-Sun). Times are representative trips built from published operating windows and headways:
- 155I Queimados x Nova Iguaçu via Dutra: Mon-Sat 03:40-23:00 every 20min (Queimados dir), NI dir 04:20-24:00 every 20min; Sun every 30min. Modeled with early/mid/late representative trips per direction.
- 607I Nova Iguaçu x Paraíso via Mariléia: weekday first ~04:00, every 20-30min to ~23:30; ~54min run time.
- 608I Nova Iguaçu x N.S. do Rosário: daily from 04:00 every ~30min.
- 585I Nova Iguaçu x Jaceruba (rural via Rio d'Ouro): sparse rural schedule, representative trips only.

Confidence 0.42: route list and operating hours/headways are well-sourced and real; stop chains are skeletal (endpoints + a few evidenced waypoints, some coordinates approximate) rather than the full ordered Moovit stop lists, and intermediate stop_times are interpolated over the run time. Directions and headways are faithful; fine-grained stop geometry is not.
